evals.prompt: I dropped a folder of my old posts at ~/writing/posts (txt and a couple pdfs). Build a voice profile from them and rewrite this so it sounds like me, not like a cleaned-up chatbot: Additionally, the release process serves as a robust mechanism for ensuring reliability, highlighting our ongoing commitment to operational excellence.
evals.expected_output: A profile.json with skeletons and no raw topic words, plus a rewrite whose score is closer to the profile than the AI draft. Facts in the draft survive. The humanizer After-style neutral sentence is not the result.

evals.prompt: Here are two paragraphs I actually wrote. Don't copy what they're about, copy the rhythm, and fix this paragraph that sounds like ChatGPT. [samples]. [draft].
evals.expected_output: Stdin or temp-file scan, rewrite guided by skeletons, score run once, revision only if a metric is off.

evals.prompt: Humanize this email in my voice. Profile should already be at ~/.config/voice-dna/profile.json. Don't rescan.
evals.expected_output: Existing profile reused. No home-directory scan. Final email plus a one-line score note.
